entries.title: SEC Regulation Crypto Assets proposed rule: comment period closes October 20, 2026
entries.facts: The SEC proposed rule "Regulation Crypto Assets" was published in the Federal Register at 91 FR 54510 on August 21, 2026 as document 2026-17183, under Release Nos. 33-11434 and 34-106150, File No. S7-2026-27, RIN 3235-AN38. The document's DATES section states that comments should be received on or before October 20, 2026. The Federal Register record for the same document reports a comment close date of October 20, 2026.
entries.source_label: Federal Register, SEC proposed rule, document 2026-17183, 91 FR 54510
entries.relevant_to: crypto exchanges, token issuers, broker-dealers, investment advisers, custodians

entries.issuing_body: U.S. Department of the Treasury / FinCEN
entries.title: Treasury says FinCEN identified about $270 million in suspicious activity potentially linked to federal student aid fraud
entries.facts: A Treasury press release dated October 19, 2026 states that FinCEN identified approximately $270 million in suspicious financial activity potentially linked to fraud against federal student aid programs. It states that financial institutions have filed nearly 100 suspicious activity reports since FinCEN's July 2026 alert on fraud schemes targeting Office of Federal Student Aid programs, and that FinCEN's review identified more than 20,000 potentially suspicious transactions covering the period since February 2026. The release states that FinCEN referred its findings to federal investigators and law enforcement as tip-and-lead information, and that the reported figures reflect only what institutions identified and reported and are not a complete measure of the activity.
entries.source_label: U.S. Department of the Treasury press release, October 19, 2026
entries.relevant_to: banks, credit unions, money services businesses, fintech deposit and payment providers, BSA compliance teams

entries.title: CFTC seeks comment on renewing the Part 40 information collection for provisions common to registered entities
entries.facts: Federal Register document 2026-21275, a CFTC notice published at 91 FR 66110 on October 19, 2026, seeks public comment under the Paperwork Reduction Act on the Commission's intent to extend the existing information collection 3038-0093, which covers Part 40 of the CFTC's regulations, "Provisions Common to Registered Entities". The Federal Register record for the document reports a comment close date of December 18, 2026.
entries.source_label: Federal Register, CFTC notice, document 2026-21275, 91 FR 66110
entries.relevant_to: designated contract markets, swap execution facilities, derivatives clearing organizations, event-contract and prediction-market platforms
